# I need help with pests, mold, and trash

Description: Report housing health problems and get help through 311.

## What to know
Section heading: What we inspect
Section body: We inspect pests, mold, sewage, and trash hazards that affect your health.

## Report to 311
Section heading: Start your complaint with 311
Section body: All complaints start with 311. 311 accepts every housing health complaint, records your details, and sends eligible cases to Healthy Housing and Vector Control (HHVC) for review and next steps.
Button link: Start your report with 311
Phone number: 311

## What to do
Section heading: Share clear details
Section body: Describe the problem, where it is happening, and how it affects your health so HHVC can review and schedule follow-up when needed.

## Related
- Help with pests and bugs

Description: Learn fee deadlines, late costs, and what to do next.

# I want to stop mosquitoes around me

Description: Learn simple mosquito prevention steps and workshop options.

## What to know
Section heading: Why mosquito prevention matters
Section body: Standing water and outdoor clutter can increase mosquito activity near homes and schools.

## What to do
Section heading: Start with prevention basics
Section body: Remove standing water each week and share prevention tips in your community.
